title: `_validateSpotMarket` incorrectly validates spot market
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The _validateSpotMarket() function is intended to ensure that the given spotMarket is valid for the provided assetIndex_, by checking if the market contains both the asset and USDC (as the system assumes all assets are priced against USDC). However, the current logic uses an OR condition:  ```solidity if (spotInfo.tokens[i] == USDC_SPOT_INDEX || spotInfo.tokens[i] == assetIndex_) {     return true; } ``` Since all valid spot markets pair assets against USDC, USDC_SPOT_INDEX (0) will always appear in one of the tokens.
